chassis.prompt: Precision edit for a motorcycle app layer system. Preserve this full 1536x1024 motorcycle image's exact size, position, wheel centers, silhouette, seat, forks, windshield if present, radiator, headlamp, rack if present, frame and engine. Remove ONLY (1) ALL pearl WHITE fuel-tank paint panels and their filler cap, including the white side shroud if present, leaving transparent empty regions where those panels were; (2) the low black exhaust silencer over the rear wheel and its immediate rear connector, leaving the engine's FRONT exhaust header and lower curved pipe intact, ending near x=850,y=840, so a separate exhaust can connect there. Reveal rear wheel/frame plausibly behind removed silencer. Output the chassis base only, no tank and no rear muffler. Keep all other geometry exactly unchanged. True fully transparent alpha outside motorcycle AND in removed-panel regions, no background noise, no glow or shadow, no other additions, no recentering or zoom. Keep original emoji style.

tank.prompt: Precision sprite extraction. Keep ONLY ALL WHITE fuel tank panels (including the white radiator-side shroud if present) AND silver filler cap from this motorcycle reference at their exact original size and position.
